title: Virtual TPM PCR-bound sealing and attestation
summary: Binds sealed secrets and attestation quotes to expected TPM 2.0 PCR measurements via a virtual TPM device.

expected_pcr_indices.description: Comma-separated PCR indices bound to the sealing or attestation policy.

sealed_object_purpose.description: Protected secret or attestation operation governed by the vTPM policy.

requirement.title: Virtual TPM PCR binding for {{sealed_object_purpose}} on {{tpm_device}}
requirement.statement: When performing {{sealed_object_purpose}}, the platform shall bind secrets and attestation quotes to {{pcr_bank}} PCRs {{expected_pcr_indices}} via vTPM device {{tpm_device}}.
requirement.rationale: Prevents secret unsealing or attestation acceptance when boot, firmware, or measured runtime state deviates from the authorized baseline.

preconditions: vTPM device {{tpm_device}} is attached and initialized.
{{pcr_bank}} PCRs {{expected_pcr_indices}} match the expected measured baseline.
positive_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Read {{pcr_bank}} PCRs {{expected_pcr_indices}} from {{tpm_device}}, generate a signed quote, and execute {{sealed_object_purpose}} against the baseline PCR policy.
positive_case.expected_result: vTPM {{tpm_device}} returns a valid {{pcr_bank}} quote over PCRs {{expected_pcr_indices}}, signature verification passes, and {{sealed_object_purpose}} succeeds.
positive_case.observable_evidence: tpm2_pcrread and tpm2_quote output on {{tpm_device}} covering {{pcr_bank}} PCRs {{expected_pcr_indices}}, verified signature, and successful {{sealed_object_purpose}}.
positive_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff {{tpm_device}} quote verifies over {{pcr_bank}} PCRs {{expected_pcr_indices}} and {{sealed_object_purpose}} succeeds under baseline measurements; FAIL otherwise.
positive_case.negative_or_failure_case: Paired negative case: extending any PCR in {{expected_pcr_indices}} causes {{sealed_object_purpose}} unseal or quote verification to fail.
positive_case.oracle_source: TCG TPM 2.0 Library Specification (TPM2_Quote, TPM2_Unseal, and PCR policy authorization).

preconditions: vTPM device {{tpm_device}} is attached with a policy bound to {{pcr_bank}} PCRs {{expected_pcr_indices}}.
negative_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Extend one PCR in {{expected_pcr_indices}} on {{tpm_device}} with a non-baseline measurement and attempt {{sealed_object_purpose}} unseal or quote verification.
negative_case.expected_result: vTPM {{tpm_device}} rejects the policy with TPM_RC_POLICY_FAIL (or quote verification rejects the PCR mismatch) without releasing secret material.
negative_case.observable_evidence: Non-zero exit status with TPM_RC_POLICY_FAIL or PCR-mismatch rejection on {{tpm_device}} and zero secret material released.
negative_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff altered {{pcr_bank}} PCR in {{expected_pcr_indices}} causes policy rejection and blocks {{sealed_object_purpose}}; FAIL if unseal or attestation succeeds.
negative_case.negative_or_failure_case: Fails if {{sealed_object_purpose}} succeeds despite tampered PCRs in {{expected_pcr_indices}} or missing {{tpm_device}}.
negative_case.oracle_source: TCG TPM 2.0 Library Specification TPM_RC_POLICY_FAIL PCR mismatch semantics.
